request.prompt: ONE continuous 6-second 16:9 silent scientific-documentary aerial shot, one location, no cuts. @start_image fixes the exact invented estuary geometry: the same river enters from the upper right through the tidal channel to the broad sea on the left; the same sandbars, banks, low hills, foreground rocky headland and water-attached triangular computation mesh must persist without morphing. This is a qualitative explanatory hydrodynamic/salinity MODEL scene, not a real measured output. CAMERA: a real wide 28mm drone camera travels SIDEWAYS about 40 metres to camera-left along the offshore side of the foreground headland, slightly cranes upward, and counter-yaws gently to keep the river mouth near centre; constant distant framing, no forward approach, no digital zoom, no static pan. The close headland must slide visibly faster across frame than the far hills and coast, giving unmistakable depth parallax while the whole connected estuary remains visible. MODEL ACTION, timed and physically coherent: 0-2s hold the start state, small seaward flow arrows already on the channel and a narrow muted pale-cyan low-salinity tongue at the river outlet; 2-4s that same continuous tongue advects from the inner estuary toward the mouth along the actual wet channel, gradually broadens by mixing while the camera travels sideways; 4-6s its leading edge spreads only into adjacent nearshore water, fading smoothly into dark-blue open sea, while a few short flow arrows update smoothly in the SAME seaward direction along the local water paths. The arrows correspond to the same instant's current and never point simultaneously upstream. The mesh remains registered to the water surface and coastline, slightly finer at complex banks and coarser offshore; the land, dry flats, vegetation and buildings remain uncoloured and ungridded. Photographic water texture, waves and shadows stay natural beneath the restrained translucent field. No change of site, added island or channel, tidal reversal, detached floating mesh, glowing laser, map UI, legends, coordinates, numbers, labels, logos or exaggerated neon effects. Finish on the same coherent coast with clearly advanced water-only field and clear lateral parallax for the next cut to satellite processing.
